definitions.explanation: A regular fee paid for the management and maintenance of shared facilities, especially in condominiums and rental properties.

examples.japanese: {管理費|かんりひ}は{毎月|まいつき}{1万円|いちまんえん}です。
examples.english: The management fee is 10,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}とは{別|べつ}に{管理費|かんりひ}がかかる。
examples.english: There's a management fee on top of the rent.

examples.japanese: {管理費|かんりひ}で{共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}の{清掃|せいそう}が{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: Common areas are cleaned using the management fee.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{管理|かんり} (management) + {費|ひ} (expense, fee)

WHAT IT COVERS:
・{共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}の{清掃|せいそう} (cleaning of common areas)
・{エレベーター}{維持|いじ} (elevator maintenance)
・{防犯|ぼうはん}カメラ (security cameras)
・{管理人|かんりにん}{費用|ひよう} (building manager costs)
・{共用|きょうよう}{電気|でんき}{代|だい} (common area electricity)

RELATED FEES:
・{共益費|きょうえきひ} (common expense fee - similar meaning)
・{修繕|しゅうぜん}{積立金|つみたてきん} (repair reserve fund - for condos)
・{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}{代|だい} (parking fee)

RENTAL LISTINGS:
In Japanese property listings, you'll often see:
・{家賃|やちん} ¥80,000 + {管理費|かんりひ} ¥5,000
・Or written as: {管理費|かんりひ}{込|こ}み (management fee included)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{管理費|かんりひ}を{払|はら}う (to pay the management fee)
・{管理費|かんりひ}が{高|たか}い/{安|やす}い (management fee is high/low)
・{管理費|かんりひ}{込|こ}み (including management fee)
・{月額|げつがく}{管理費|かんりひ} (monthly management fee)
